description: This file defines a template class `PeriodicController` that inherits from `ThreadController` and provides a base class for controllers requiring periodic execution. It manages setting up periodic callbacks (`PeriodicTask`) with configurable frequency, and handles thread sleep timing to maintain consistent execution intervals. The class is designed to be inherited for specific periodic tasks such as control loops in embedded systems.

classes.name: PeriodicController
classes.description: A template class providing a framework for creating periodic controllers in embedded or real-time systems.

methods.name: void OnStarted()
methods.description: Virtual method called before the periodic task begins; meant to be overridden for setup.

methods.name: PeriodicTask
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be overridden, defining the periodic work to perform.

methods.name: void ThreadTask()
methods.description: Final override that runs in the thread, calling `OnStarted()` and repeatedly executing `PeriodicTask` at specified intervals.

methods.name: PeriodicController(const char * name,tprio_t priority,float frequencyHz)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the periodicity based on desired frequency.
